 /// Skipping it leaves the current policy's SETTLED deferred record without a vault lock.\n    function onDeferredPayoutFunded(bytes32 intentHash) external;\n}\n","keccak256":"0xd68775fef8e2c21982f9709249f68f133eb20b39022e3a1cd56cdd2c77415f99","license":"MIT"},"contracts/interfaces/INullifierRegistry.sol":{"content":"//SPDX-License-Identifier: devdoc.details: Deferred payouts are stake locks funded by the payout. The token must have no transfer callbacks (canonical USDC only). StakeVaultV2 owns collateral accounting; the dedicated dispute registry owns replay state. TRUST: Authorized orchestrators must invoke callbacks only for their own validated intents and escrows. Settlement uses the depositor and token captured before escrow unlock and never reads escrow. Only the deposit opt-out setter reads escrow to authenticate its depositor. Intent hashes must embed the originating orchestrator so identities cannot collide. Governance must keep orchestrators authorized on predecessor policies until their snapshotted intents drain. Authorize a successor policy alongside its predecessor in StakeVaultV2 and select it on O4 for new intents and settlements. The predecessor keeps serving its own locks; de-authorize it only after its locks drain. Any authorized vault controller can lock any owner's free stake and pay out that free stake only to its owner. Protection applies only to stake-token deposits with a nonzero attested window supplied in the signed extension. There are no per-method windows or paused admissions. Whitelisted takers, manual releases and zero windows settle without a record or event. Relayer membership is read from the calling authorized orchestrator's current registry at settlement. Registered relayer takers bypass collateral by default; only the depositor can opt their deposit out of this bypass. Non-stake tokens return without a record or event. Protected settlements lock gross stake or defer the net payout until now plus the attested window; only these STAKE and DEFERRED_PAYOUT settlements emit DisputeProtectionIntentSettled.

claimFor(bytes32).details: Only the taker or recipient may call. A partial payout leaves the remainder claimable later.     The record tracks claimed amounts, not which stake units came from the payout. The released payout     is ordinary free stake of the recipient.     If the recipient withdraws that stake directly first, a later claimFor (including one by the taker)     pays the unclaimed amount, capped at the recipient's free stake, out of the recipient's other free stake.     Funds only ever reach the recipient, so this is accepted. Per-payout accounting in the vault would     be needed to prevent it.
